scope: MWG Chapter 3, parts A and B (pp. 40-75 and Exercises 3.B.1-3.G.18, pp. 96-102): preference properties, preference and utility, the utility and expenditure minimization problems, duality, and the relations between demand, indirect utility and expenditure functions; Mathematical Appendix M.C, M.E, M.F, M.G, M.J, M.K and M.L. Part C (3.H-3.J, Appendix 3.A) is added by later modules.
source: Mas-Colell, Whinston and Green, Microeconomic Theory (Oxford University Press, 1995), Chapter 3. Exact scope: docs/source-map.md and docs/source-map-B.md.
